New Sonesta Dahabeya Amirat II We’re excited to announce the launch of our newest vessel — the Sonesta Dahabeya Amirat II. Designed for unforgettable journeys along the Nile, this beautifully crafted boat blends elevated comfort with authentic charm, making it ideal for scenic cruises or stylish private charters. Explore Our New Cruise Featured Properties Explore Our Hotels in Egypt Sonesta St. George Hotel - Luxor Sonesta St. George Hotel Luxor redefines magnificent contemporary style. Come and enjoy a sweeping terrace with majestic views of the Nile, a grand entrance of polished marble and handsomely appointed furnishings with exquisite detail. View Property Sonesta Hotel, Tower & Casino - Cairo A stay at the five-star Sonesta Hotel, Tower & Casino - Cairo will leave a lasting impression. The Cairo International Convention Centre is within walking distance and the Cairo International Airport is just 15 minutes away from the hotel. View Property Sonesta Nouba Hotel Aswan The Sonesta Nouba Hotel Aswan invites you to immerse yourself in a luxe getaway infused with the vibrant culture and spectacular scenery of this ancient city on the Nile. View Property Explore Nile River Cruises Sonesta Nile River Cruises Explore the landmark temples, tombs, and ruins on a three, four, and seven-night trip as you sail between Aswan and Luxor. Enjoy upscale hospitality and watch 5,000 years of history unfold before you on an unforgettable journey through ancient Egypt.
